purpose: Small descriptive coursework study; demonstrate Boolean search quality using a fixed set of minute snapshots and purposive article review.
selection_rule: Reuse the successful 2026-09-09 20:16 UTC probe and select the same minute at five-day intervals before/after it, one date in each phase. Fixed before downloading additional files; convenience snapshots, not a probability sample.
review_rule: Select about 12-16 cases from broad/core/issue matches to include direct product reporting, comparative or launch roundups, and likely incidental matches. Use retrieved article text to judge relevance; inaccessible cases remain unknown. This diagnostic case selection is not an unbiased precision estimate.
completion_target: Boolean query registry and comparison counts, review evidence table, 2-3 figures and a short Chinese report. Country comparison is limited to verified outlet cases if coverage is sparse.
